name: Fiat24 Card
summary: Swiss regulated Web3 debit card with IBAN. Built on Arbitrum blockchain with NFT-based account credentials. FINMA licensed.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Fiat24 Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Fiat24 Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
